gen_target_from_ee_pos: generate a RobotTarget from a given end-effector 3D position using inverse kinematics and collision checks
gen_target_from_obj_idx: generate a RobotTarget for a specified object index by sampling grasp points on its bounding sphere
_gen_goal_state: compute feasible joint positions to reach a desired end-effector target using randomized inverse kinematics search
_bounding_sphere_sample: sample candidate grasp points on an object bounding sphere and find valid collision-free joint configurations
get_def_js: return the default reference joint state array for the robot arm as a numpy array
